fields.description: Weekly issue featuring editorials and political commentary on Florida elections and candidates (including the governorship race), local Dade County governance and law-enforcement matters, and discussion of road and highway conditions (including the Tamiami Trail). Includes coverage of prohibition enforcement and liquor seizures, community notes and humor columns, entertainment listings, and numerous local advertisements and political campaign notices.
